text_zh: 杭州政协网转载的2023年8月7日《每日商报》报道，将岳王庙列为每天开放的第一类场馆，并描述其全年开放；本条据此记录普通每周无固定闭馆日。这是较早的官方门户转载报道，不是2026年新公告，也不保证当天、园内每个设施或临时展厅均开放；行前查看景区最新安排。普通入园是否必须预约、提前天数尚未核定，不能将内部岳飞纪念馆的安排或普通西湖湖岸规则代替岳王庙的预约要求。
text_en: A Meiri Shangbao (每日商报) report dated 7 August 2023, republished on Hangzhou’s CPPCC portal, places Yue Fei Temple in the category of venues opening daily and describes it as open year-round. This entry uses that report for no fixed ordinary weekly closing day. It is an older report on an official portal, rather than a new 2026 notice, and does not guarantee access on a particular day or to every facility or temporary exhibition. Check the attraction’s latest arrangements before travelling. Mandatory admission reservations and advance booking days remain unconfirmed. Rules for the internal Yue Fei Memorial Museum or West Lake’s public lakeshore do not establish the temple’s reservation requirement.
